driving_mode: A manual host used the real queue API, invoked image generation, inspected pixels, and submitted reviews. Not an autonomous skill or Claude generation benchmark.

runs.prompt:
LOCKED DESIGN CONTRACT: photo starter design
[palette] Use a warm cream backdrop and restrained neutral colors. Keep the same color grading across the set; retain any supplied product colors.
[lighting] Soft diffused window light from the upper left, gentle contact shadows, and natural exposure throughout the set.
[finish] Editorial product photography with realistic materials and a matte finish. No glossy CGI, decorative gradients, or floating objects.
[layout] One clear focal subject, clean background, and generous breathing room. Keep the same visual density across the set.
[exclusions] Do not invent a real brand, logo, product claims, label text, or watermark. A supplied real product must retain its actual packaging.
Only these dimensions may change between images: angle.
All other design decisions remain fixed. If the concept conflicts with a locked rule, resolve the conflict before generation; do not silently weaken the contract.

Create one standalone image for this brief: Make 2 square skincare product photos.
This is one output in the requested set; do not combine the set into a collage or grid.

Variation for this image: The same unbranded matte skincare pump bottle, with only a slight three-quarter change of camera angle.

Target aspect ratio 1:1.

Use the first reviewed batch image as an additional style anchor for palette, lighting, texture, and finish only. The requested subject, text, pose, and layout still come from this job and its locked contract.

review.notes: The requested three-quarter camera angle is not clearly distinguishable from the front-on anchor. Turn the viewpoint about 30 degrees around the bottle so the pump spout visibly foreshortens, while preserving the same product, light, background, and framing.

checks.observed: The bottle and backdrop retain the warm cream and beige treatment of the anchor.
Soft upper-left illumination and rightward contact shadow match the first image.
The pump bottle remains matte with a realistic textured surface and soft highlights.
A single centered bottle and surrounding negative space match the anchor's density.
No text, logo, product claims, or watermark is visible.
